groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: water, and things that flow like it.

chars.story: Water running up into the lanes of a town: a port.
chars.note: Short for Hong Kong: 港元 'HK dollar'.

chars.story: Water trickling away until only a little is left: diminish.
chars.note: Also 'consume': 消费.

chars.story: The master pouring water exactly where it should go.
chars.note: Also 'note, comment', standing for traditional 註.

chars.story: Water at its origin, the spring under the cliff: the source.
Water as fresh as young green shoots: clear.
chars.note: Also the Qing dynasty, 清朝.

chars.story: Water spreading out and playing over the ground, as a show unfolds: perform.
A region with water all round it: a continent.
chars.note: 州 alone is an inland region; 洲 has the water.

groups.title: person 亻 人
groups.note: 人 on the left as 亻, or stacked three times.

chars.story: A person who can change things easily: convenient.
chars.note: In formal prose also 'then', like 就.

chars.story: A person who stays put: he lives there.
chars.note: After a verb, 'firmly': 记住 'remember', 抓住 'grab'.

chars.story: A person holding things out in both hands: supply.
Three people together: a crowd.
chars.note: Traditional 眾 had 目 over the people.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: 木 on the left or at the foot.

chars.story: At dawn behind a tree, peering out: look into it.
Wooden beams crossed into a schoolhouse frame: school.
Timbers hooked into one another: construct.
chars.note: Traditional 構: 冓 became 勾.

chars.story: A wooden table where disputes are settled in peace: a case.
chars.note: Also 'plan, file': 方案, 档案 'archive'.

chars.story: Standing close by the family tree: a relative.
chars.note: Also 'close, in person' and 'kiss'. Traditional 親 had 見 on the right.

groups.title: money 贝 钅
groups.note: 贝 is a cowrie shell, the oldest money; 钅 is metal. Both mean wealth.

chars.story: Shells going out and not coming back: a fee.
Shell money tested under the axe: is it good? Its quality.
chars.note: Traditional 質 had two axes on top.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 共 two hands + 贝 shell
chars.story: Under one roof, hands reaching for the shell prize: a competition.
chars.note: Traditional 賽.

chars.story: Metal coins: money.
chars.note: Traditional 錢: 金 on the left became 钅.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: 口: a mouth, or any opening.

chars.story: A mouth wide open: ah!
chars.note: An interjection. At a sentence's end it adds warmth: 好啊 'sure!'.

chars.story: A mouth asking 'that one?': which?
chars.note: Without the mouth, 那 is 'that'.

chars.parts: 口 four vessels + 犬 dog
chars.story: A dog guarding four pots: vessels, tools, devices.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'vessel / tool'.

chars.story: A drum beating and a mouth singing: glad.
chars.note: 喜欢 'like' is the commonest word.

groups.title: words 言 讠
groups.note: 言 whole, or squeezed to 讠 on the left.

chars.parts: - lines of breath from a mouth
chars.story: Breath coming out of a mouth in lines.
chars.note: His Analects card. Modern prose uses it formally: 发言 'make a statement'.

chars.story: Words stored up in one mind: knowledge.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'remember' (識). 认识 is 'know a person'. 戠 on the right became 只.

chars.story: Words called out at a bird rustling in the branches: who's there?
chars.note: Also 'anyone': 谁都知道 'everyone knows'. Traditional 誰.

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Small words that hold a sentence together.

chars.story: One more laid on top of the stack: moreover.
chars.note: Literary 'for now': 暂且.

chars.parts: 去 go + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: Setting off, then kneeling back down: however.
chars.note: Usually alone before a verb: 他却不来 'yet he didn't come'.

chars.parts: 艮 food bowl + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: A man kneeling right up at the bowl: here, now, this one.
chars.note: Also 'at once' (立即), and in formal prose 'is': 即是.

chars.parts: - a tree with an extra branch
chars.story: A tree whose top branches have not yet grown out.
chars.note: Lookalike 末 'end' has the longer stroke on top.

groups.title: sun 日 and light
groups.note: 日 is the sun; these shine, glow or ripen in it.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 召 summon + 灬 fire
chars.story: Sun and fire summoned together: they shine on everything.
chars.note: 按照 'according to' is very common in prose.

chars.story: The sun's rays falling freely, no effort at all: easy.
chars.note: Also 'change, exchange': 交易 'trade'.

chars.story: Grain ripening in the sun: fragrant.
A man walking with fire held over his head: light.
chars.note: Also 'only, used up': 吃光 'eat it all up'.

chars.story: The first white glow before the sun is up.
chars.note: His Analects card. Also 'in vain, for free': 白跑 'go for nothing'.

groups.title: roof 宀 and cave 穴
groups.note: 宀 is a roof; 穴 is a roof with an opening: a cave.

chars.story: A roof as wide as a valley: it can contain anything.
chars.note: Also 'face, looks': 笑容 'smile'.

chars.story: A cave dug out by work: empty inside.
chars.note: Also 'sky' and 'free time'.

chars.story: Nine turns into the cave, right to the end: investigate.

groups.title: child 子
groups.note: 子 is a child with arms out.

chars.story: A child under the schoolroom roof, learning characters.
A child still small enough to carry: a young child.

groups.title: sound and voice
groups.note: Noise, voices, echoes.

chars.story: Once 言 words with a mark held in the mouth: just a noise, not words.

chars.parts: - the top of a hanging chime
chars.story: A stone chime hanging from its frame, ringing out: a voice.
chars.note: Traditional 聲 had 耳 ear at the foot; only the chime is left.

chars.story: A mouth shouting toward the hills, and back it comes: an echo.
chars.note: Also 'loud, to ring'. Above all in 影响 'influence'.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: 土 on the left or at the foot: soil, land, building.

chars.story: The ground around you, up to where it ends: your circumstances.
chars.note: Also 'border': 入境 'enter a country'.

chars.story: Layer after layer of earth piled on: increase.
Clay pressed into a cut mould: every piece the same type.

groups.title: cart 车
groups.note: 车 is a cart seen from above: body, axle, wheels.

chars.story: A cart wheel turning like a spindle: turn.
chars.note: Also 'pass on': 转发 'forward'. Traditional 轉.

chars.story: Two carts crossing side by side: compare them.
chars.note: Before an adjective, 'rather': 较大 'rather large'.

chars.story: Carts rolling one after another down the road: linked.
chars.note: 连…都 'even': 连他都不知道 'even he doesn't know'.

groups.title: mind and spirit
groups.note: Thinking, breathing, the spirit.

chars.story: Head and heart working on it together: think it over.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'think'. 想 is the everyday 'think'.

chars.story: Air from the nose down to the heart: breath.
chars.note: Also 'news' (消息, 信息) and 'rest' (休息).

chars.story: Lightning striking over the altar: a god.

groups.title: head
groups.note: The head, and what comes first.

chars.parts: - a head with hair on top
chars.story: A head with tufts of hair: the chief, the first.
chars.note: Also a counter for poems and songs: 一首歌.

chars.story: Each head of work written up in a list: a listed item.
chars.note: Traditional 項: 頁 became 页.

groups.title: on foot
groups.note: Walking, stepping, following, leaving.

chars.parts: 土 running man + 止 foot
chars.story: A man swinging his arms above a striding foot: go on foot.
chars.note: Also 'leave': 他走了 'he has left'.

chars.parts: 止 foot + 少 second foot
chars.story: One foot ahead of the other: a step.
A foot right at your heel: follow closely.
chars.note: Very often 'with': 跟他说 'talk with him'. Also 'heel': 高跟鞋.

chars.parts: - a net over a trapped creature
chars.story: The creature slips out of the net and is gone: part from it.
chars.note: In distances, 'from': 离这儿很远 'far from here'. Traditional 離 had 隹 bird on the right.

groups.title: learning
groups.note: Study, research, reckoning, writing.

chars.story: Grinding on the stone, again and again: research.
chars.note: The first sense is 'grind'.

chars.story: A newborn, head down, with flesh still to grow: bring it up.

chars.parts: ⺮ bamboo + 目 eye + 廾 hands
chars.story: Bamboo sticks under the eye, hands moving them: it all counts.
chars.note: Also 'calculate': 计算. 不算 'doesn't count'.

chars.parts: 冖 cover + 与 hooked strokes
chars.story: A sheet laid flat, and a hooked stroke dashed beneath: write.
chars.note: Traditional 寫 had 宀 roof over 舄.

groups.title: hands 扌 又
groups.note: A hand on the left, as 扌 or as 又.

chars.story: A hand hurling a club: throw.
A hand holding the door shut against intruders: defend.
chars.note: Traditional 護 had 言 words and 蒦.

chars.story: A hand shading the eyes, looking hard: observe.
chars.note: His Analects card in 觀: 雚 on the left became 又, 見 became 见. Also 'view': 观点.

chars.parts: 又 hand + 欠 open mouth
chars.story: Hands up and mouth wide open: joyous.
chars.note: Traditional 歡: 雚 became 又.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants and growing things.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: Grass sprouting again and a man kneeling in thanks: a festival.
chars.note: Also 'segment, joint' (细节 'detail') and 'save' (节省). Traditional 節 had 竹 bamboo.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 犭 dog + 犬 dog
chars.story: Hunting dogs flushing game out of the grass: obtain.
chars.note: It stands for both 獲 'catch' and 穫 'harvest'.

groups.title: body 尸
groups.note: 尸 is a body, bent or lying down.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 口 small room
chars.story: A body bent over a desk in a small room: an office.
chars.note: Also 'situation' (局势) and a round of a game: 一局棋.

chars.story: A tail joined to its body: it belongs there.
chars.note: Traditional 屬 had 尾 tail on top.

groups.title: striking and removing
groups.note: Killing, hitting, getting rid of.

chars.story: A blade slashed across the tree: cut down, kill.
chars.note: Traditional 殺 had 殳 club on the right.

chars.parts: - a pole driven into a hollow
chars.story: A pole driven down hard into a hollow: strike.
chars.note: Traditional 擊.

chars.story: The mound cleared of everything, all except what remains.
chars.note: Also 'remove': 消除, 开除, and 'divide' in sums.

groups.title: work and trades
groups.note: Kinds of work, and the law over them.

chars.story: Goods laid out under an awning: commerce.
chars.note: Also 'discuss': 商量. The Shang dynasty is 商.

chars.story: A peasant's rough coat bent low over the field: agriculture.
chars.note: Traditional 農 had 辰, a shell hoe.

chars.story: A box for arrows pulled out of wounds: medicine.
chars.note: Traditional 醫 had 殳 and 酉 wine below.

chars.story: An ear open for one thing only: your duty.
chars.note: Traditional 職: 戠 became 只.

chars.story: A brush writing down every step you may take: the law code.
chars.note: Also 'rhythm': 旋律 'melody'.

groups.title: regions
groups.note: China and its divisions.

chars.story: Blossom bursting into ten petals, splendid: the flower of the land, China.
chars.note: Also 'splendid': 华丽 'gorgeous'. Traditional 華 had 艹 flowers on top.

chars.story: Dry land between the strands of a river: a prefecture.
chars.note: Ends many city names: 广州, 杭州. Also a US 'state'.

chars.story: An eye taking in a little at a time: land too big to see whole, a province.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'examine'. Also 'save': 省钱 'save money'.

groups.title: strength 力
groups.note: 力 on the right: effort.

chars.story: Putting your strength under the stack: assist.
Walking with effort right out to the edge: the side.
chars.note: 一边…一边 'while': 一边吃一边说. Traditional 邊.

groups.title: getting ready
groups.note: Creating, preparing, packing, putting in order.

chars.story: Cutting the first timbers for a granary: create.
chars.note: Also 'wound': 创伤.

chars.story: A foot set at the edge of the field, ready: prepare.
chars.note: Traditional 備 had 亻 on the left.

chars.story: A strong man stuffing clothes into a bag: pack.
chars.note: Also 'install', 'dress' and 'pretend'. Traditional 裝.

chars.parts: 束 bundle + 攵 tap + 正 straight
chars.story: Tapping the bundle until it stands straight and whole: entire.
chars.note: Also 'put in order': 整理 'tidy up'.

chars.parts: 目 vessel + 八 two hands
chars.story: Two hands holding up a vessel: a tool.

groups.title: cloth and paper
groups.note: Weaving, sheets, printing, raw stuff.

chars.story: Silk worked thread by thread: weave.
chars.note: Above all in 组织 'organization'. Traditional 織: 戠 became 只.

chars.story: A bow drawn long and opened out flat: a sheet.
chars.note: A counter for flat things: 一张纸. Also a common surname.

chars.parts: 片 slice + 反 turn over
chars.story: A slice of wood carved, inked and turned over: an edition.
Rice in the measuring scoop: material.
chars.note: Also 'expect': 没料到 'didn't expect'.

groups.title: shapes learned whole
groups.note: Pictures and shapes with no handy parts.

chars.parts: - two lines with a cross between
chars.story: Two lines with a cross between them: five.
chars.note: His Analects card.

chars.story: A snake coiled tight round a branch: cling to.
chars.note: Mostly a tail on body words, and in foreign names: 巴黎 Paris, 巴西 Brazil.

chars.story: An elephant drawn whole, all its outward appearance.
chars.note: Also 'elephant': 大象. With 亻, 像 is 'resemble'.

chars.story: A fence round a lucky field, walked in a full circle: a week.
chars.note: Also 'circle, all round': 周围. The Zhou dynasty is 周.

chars.parts: - a hand with something slipping off
chars.story: A hand with something slipping off it: lose.
chars.note: His Analects card.

chars.story: A sail frame with a cross swinging inside: wind.
chars.note: Also 'style, custom': 风格. Traditional 風 had 虫 insect inside.

chars.story: Cloth so finely cross-woven you can only hope to own it.
chars.note: Almost only in 希望 'hope' and 希腊 'Greece'.

sentences.en: This work is not necessarily easy.
There are five people in this photo.
I'll see as I walk along.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪种类型的音乐？
sentences.en: What genres of music are you into?

sentences.zh: 他对我的研究提供建议。
sentences.en: He advised me on my study.

sentences.zh: 你想要哪种风格的家具？
sentences.en: What style of furniture would you like?

sentences.zh: 我一整周都不能去学校了。
sentences.en: I couldn't go to school for a whole week.

sentences.zh: 跟其它的比，法国护照有多难看啊。
sentences.en: Compared to the others, doesn't the French passport look ugly?

sentences.zh: 即便她不喜欢你，你也要完成工作。
sentences.en: Even if she doesn't like you, you still have to finish the work.

sentences.zh: 我希望离开那个城市，并且不再回来。
sentences.en: I hope to leave that city, and never come back.
